##### Project general facts

Fleurs de Jardin is an exclusive limited collection of luxury villas and mansions presented by AMIS Development in collaboration with the legendary jewelry house Jacob & Co. This gated community is inspired by the brand’s signature timepieces, conceived as an ever-changing landscape where form, light, and color come alive. Each residence is defined by bespoke finishes and exquisite craftsmanship, designed to be experienced slowly and lived in fully. 

Residents enjoy a private, gated sanctuary with landscaped gardens, a serene lagoon, winding walkways, and a retro-style clubhouse featuring swimming pools and a fully equipped fitness studio. A dedicated children’s play area and round-the-clock gated security ensure privacy and peace of mind. Mansion owners receive exclusive privileges, including access to a spa and wellness centre, enhanced basement parking, and designated spaces for a home theatre and golf simulator.

Every residence at Fleurs de Jardin reflects the artistry of Jacob & Co., with bespoke finishes and meticulous attention to detail throughout. Villas and mansions feature expansive layouts across basement, ground, and upper floors, with premium materials and designer touches at every turn. Kitchens are finished to the highest standards, and bathrooms feature luxury fixtures. The design philosophy centers on slow, intentional living, where every space is meant to be savored.

##### Location description and benefits

Wadi Al Safa 3 is an emerging area in the southern part of Dubai that offers a rare combination of tranquility and connectivity. Surrounded by established communities such as Majan and Al Barari, the area is defined by its openness, greenery, and sense of calm, making it particularly appealing for families and individuals seeking a more balanced lifestyle. Its setting allows residents to experience a quieter, nature-forward environment while remaining connected to the city’s core.

The area benefits from convenient access to major road networks, enabling smooth movement across Dubai and easy reach of key business, retail, and leisure destinations. This accessibility supports effortless daily routines while preserving a feeling of separation from dense urban congestion. The surrounding infrastructure continues to evolve, reinforcing the area’s appeal as a long-term residential destination.

With its emphasis on space, nature, and thoughtful urban planning, Wadi Al Safa 3 offers an environment that supports wellbeing and long-term livability. The district’s proximity to green communities, combined with its strategic location within Dubai, makes it an attractive choice for those seeking a lifestyle shaped by calm, connection, and future growth.
